LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_SettingAlertDesc: Show "Bills stalled" and "Construction stalled" alerts on the right when something has been stalled for most of the last day.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_SettingProbesDesc: Ask modded work givers why they can't do a bill. Always off while the Multiplayer mod is active.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_NoFix: No one-click fix yet. Use Jump to and check the bench and its bill.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_Working: Someone was working on this bill.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_BrokenDown: The {BENCH} is broken down and waiting for repair.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_InteractionBlocked: The spot where a worker stands to use the {BENCH} is blocked.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_InteractionBlockedBy: The spot where a worker stands to use the {BENCH} is blocked by {THING}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_NoColonists: There are no colonists on this map.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_WorkTypeDisabled: Nobody has {WORK} enabled in the Work tab.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_PawnRestriction: The bill's worker restriction excludes everyone who could do it, including {PAWN}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_SkillRange: {PAWN} is the best candidate with {SKILL} {LEVEL}, but the bill only allows {MIN}–{MAX}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_SkillMin: {PAWN} is the best candidate with {SKILL} {LEVEL}, but the recipe needs at least {MIN}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_AreaRestriction: {PAWN} could do the bill, but their allowed area ({AREA}) keeps them away from the {BENCH}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_WorkersUnavailable: {PAWN} could do the bill but is downed, drafted or having a mental break.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_NoneOnMap: There is no {ING} on the map.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_ExcludedByBillFilter: There is {ING} on the map, but the bill's ingredient filter excludes it.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_Forbidden: The usable {ING} is forbidden or outside the worker's allowed area.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_OutsideRadius: {COUNT} {ING} is available, but the nearest is {DIST} tiles from the bench. The bill only searches {RADIUS}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_Reserved: The usable {ING} is reserved by someone else.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_Unreachable: The usable {ING} can't be reached from the bench.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_NoStockpileAccepts: The bill takes {PRODUCT} to the best stockpile, but no stockpile accepts it, so finished items are dropped next to the bench.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_SpecificStockpileReject: The bill takes {PRODUCT} to {STOCKPILE}, which doesn't accept it, so finished items are dropped next to the bench.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_BenchBusy: {PAWN} is using the bench for another bill ({BILL}).
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_Outcompeted: {PAWN} could do this, but spent the stall on work that comes before {STALLED} in their work order: {SHARES}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_OutcompetedOnce: {PAWN} was busy with {WORK}, which comes before {STALLED} in their work order.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_OffDuty: Everyone who could do this was off duty: sleeping, eating, on recreation or outside work hours.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_SameOrLowerRank: Someone could do this, but was idle or on work that ranks the same or lower. The game may be picking closer jobs first.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_Waiting: Materials and a worker are available, but nobody has started this bill. Workers were busy with other jobs.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Why_Generic: This bench is handled by a modded work giver. Colony Doctor can't tell why it's stalled yet.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_AlertExplanation: These bills have been stalled for at least half of the last day. Click to open the Bottlenecks tab and see why.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_Working: Someone was delivering materials, clearing the site or building.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_Waiting: Nothing blocks it and a builder is available, but nobody has started. Workers were busy with other jobs.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_Incapable: No colonist is capable of construction.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_WorkTypeDisabled: Nobody has Construction enabled in the Work tab.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_SkillTooLow: {PAWN} is the best builder with {SKILL} {LEVEL}, but the {THING} needs {MIN}.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_WorkersUnavailable: {PAWN} could build it but is downed, drafted or having a mental break.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_BlockedPlant: {THING} is in the way and has to be cut first.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_BlockedItem: {THING} is in the way and has to be hauled away first.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_BlockedBuilding: {THING} is in the way and has to be deconstructed first.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_BlockedBuildingStuck: {THING} is in the way and your colony can't deconstruct it.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_BlockedRock: {THING} is in the way and has to be mined first.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_BlockedRockNoMiner: {THING} is in the way and has to be mined, but no builder has Mining enabled.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_NotEnough: Not enough {MAT}: {SHORT} more needed, {USABLE} usable on the map.
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_Forbidden: The {MAT} on the map is forbidden or outside allowed areas ({SHORT} short).
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_MatUnreachable: The {MAT} on the map can't be reached from the site ({SHORT} short).
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_Site_Reserved: The {MAT} on the map is reserved by other jobs ({SHORT} short).
LanguageData.ColonyDoctor_AlertConstructionExplanatio: These construction sites have been stalled for at least half of the last day. Click to open the Bottlenecks tab and see why.
